items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Jimmy Forrest was playing tenor. And Tommy Potter was on bass, and Clarence Johnson. I remember that band myself.

ctx.x: Jimmy Forrest was playing tenor. And Tommy Potter was on bass, and Clarence Johnson. I remember that band myself. Why I remember it and why I’m making a bigger thing out of it is because when I left the group they went, their next job, would you believe this, from out here, I forgot, we were in San Francisco or somewhere and I left and I came back here. And where did they go? They played their next gig in Rochester, New York. I’ve never played in my own home town.
